findings.title: Preserve the selected event index when mutating deferred-call leaves
findings.obligation: Malformed deferred-call function, real-valued seed state, and arity must be rejected by their leaf checks before public serialization; a legal unchanged deferred leaf must serialize.
findings.actual: The selected timer is events[0], followed by the initial-step event at events[1]. (*p.events[:-1], replacement) duplicates the timer at index1 and removes initial_step, while its procedure gate metadata still names ordinal1. All three cases fail the earlier unique procedure-gate metadata check before visiting the malformed leaf.
findings.positive_control: Original build().to_dict succeeds. Repeating the exact test placement with an unchanged legal leaf fails the same gate-metadata check. Replacing the actual index0 event preserves gate metadata and accepts the legal leaf.
findings.real_fault_calibration: An in-memory AST mutant removes only production UnsupportedSystemCall signature/seed/owner validation, retaining argument traversal. The unmodified original method still passes all three cases; index-preserving wrong-function, real-state-seed and wrong-arity controls all serialize under the mutant and are all rejected by the unmodified validator. This proves the original detector misses absent target checks, beyond a merely different error code.
findings.impact: The method cannot guard the three claimed malformed-leaf rejection obligations; regression in those leaf checks remains invisible to this test. This is a per-method conclusion, not a claim that the full suite has no other related detector.
findings.recommendation: Replace the event at its discovered index and retain an unchanged legal replacement control; assert the target leaf refusal or calibrated target-check behavior.
